Install `payments()` before building the runtime and give priced entrypoints an
explicit x402 protocol when another payment extension is also active.

```ts
const runtime = await createAgent(meta)
  .use(
    payments({
      config: {
        facilitatorUrl: 'https://x402.org/facilitator',
        network: 'eip155:84532',
        payTo: '0xYOUR_EVM_RECEIVING_ADDRESS',
      },
    })
  )
  .use(http())
  .build();
```

The HTTP extension executes one authorization transaction:

```text
challenge → verify → reserve policy capacity → fulfill → settle → record
                                      └ failure → release reservation
```

The adapter does not own this transaction. Invoke, stream, and task routes all
delegate to it.

## Current limits

- x402 v2 `exact` scheme
- one accepted payment option per challenge
- EVM and Solana mechanisms exposed by Lucid's configured networks
- no Lucid Bazaar declaration, `upto`, batch settlement, signed offers, or
  signed receipts

See the maintained [x402 support matrix](/docs/protocols/x402) before choosing a
facilitator based on features supported by the upstream protocol.
